# Official-generator contract fixture

This schema is synthetic. It exercises DDS behavior absent from the example
page: repeated children, nested data properties, dynamic text/image/color and
background bindings, optional slots, nth-item margins, input placeholders,
conditions, common flex classes, and compound dimensional CSS values.

The five files under `formatted/` were generated on 2026-09-03 by the original
unmodified `generateH5Code` function (webpack module `6ce9`, which invokes
`24c8`) extracted from the official public frontend. They were not generated by
the repository's `lanhu_codegen` implementation. The oracle used `format=true`
and `remVal=37.5`, with the frontend's own Prettier 2.5.1 and plugins.

Oracle asset:

https://dds.lanhuapp.com/js/home.ae626768.js

Its SHA-256 and the companion vendor asset are recorded in
`lanhu_codegen/source-manifest.json`. `oracle.json` records the schema and
expected-output hashes for this fixture.

This checks compatibility with the official algorithm on deliberately selected
features. The separate `official_no_permission` fixture checks the real example
against files copied directly from the official user interface. Neither test
claims every possible design can be represented by DDS.
